lines.en: label makotodorm5:
I knock on Makoto's door and wait for her to-
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Makoto 的门，等她——

lines.en: : Just a minute!
lines.zh: : 等一下！

lines.en: Well, I didn't have to wait long.
lines.zh: 嗯，我没等多久。

lines.en: I lean against the wall and wait for her to finish doing whatever it is she's doing, wondering if she'll actually let me in or not.
lines.zh: 我靠在墙上，等她把手头不知道在干的事干完，一边想她到底会不会真的让我进去。

lines.en: Given that this is Makoto we're talking about and I am a teacher, I'm sure she will.
lines.zh: 考虑到这是 Makoto，而我又是老师，我确信她会。

lines.en: But I'm also sure there will be some sort of questioning as well since this is very likely against some sort of rule.
lines.zh: 但我也确信免不了一顿盘问，因为这很可能违反了某条规定。

lines.en: scene platonicredux1
: Sorry, I was just-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我刚才在——

lines.en: : Wait...Sensei? What are you doing here? Do you need me for something? Is everything okay? Do you-
lines.zh: : 等等……老师？你在这儿干什么？你有事找我吗？一切都还好吗？你是不是——

lines.en: : Everything is fine. I was just looking to kill some time before going home for the night.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。我只是想在今晚回家前打发点时间。

lines.en: : Kill some time? And...how exactly do you plan to do that?
lines.zh: : 打发时间？那……你具体打算怎么打发？

lines.en: : Maybe...we could hang out in your room or something?
lines.zh: : 也许……我们可以在你房间里待会儿什么的？

lines.en: scene platonicredux2
: M-My room?! But...but why would you want to go in there?!
lines.zh: : 我……我的房间？！可……可你为什么想进去？！

lines.en: : It makes more sense than hanging out in the hallway, doesn't it?
lines.zh: : 总比在走廊里待着合理吧？

lines.en: : Unless you don't think we're close enough or something.
lines.zh: : 除非你觉得我们还没熟到那个份上什么的。

lines.en: scene platonicredux3
: I mean...do you really think we're that close?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你觉得我们真有那么熟吗？

lines.en: : I suppose I {i}have{/i} probably spent more time with you than anyone else, save Ami...
lines.zh: : 我想，除了 Ami 之外，我跟你待在一起的时间大概比谁都多……

lines.en: : But...I don’t know. This just seems like...a lot, all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 可……我不知道。这突然就……有点太过了。

lines.en: : Are you...uncomfortable being alone with me, Makoto? Because you seem to be making a pretty big deal out of this.
lines.zh: : 你……跟我单独待着会不自在吗，Makoto？因为你看起来把这事搞得挺大的。

lines.en: scene platonicredux2
: Because it is a big deal, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 因为它就是很大一件事啊，老师！

lines.en: : And the room is a mess anyway so-
lines.zh: : 而且房间也乱得要命，所以——

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: scene platonicredux4
: W-What?...
: If my class representative doesn't trust me enough to let me into her room, I might have to choose another one.
lines.zh: : 如果我的班长不信任我到不让我进她的房间，我可能得换一个班长了。

lines.en: scene platonicredux2
: You wouldn’t dare! Also, isn't that blackmail?!
lines.zh: : 你不敢！还有，那不是勒索吗？！

lines.en: : Is there a rule in the student handbook against blackmail?
lines.zh: : 学生手册里有禁止勒索的规定吗？

lines.en: : I don't...think so? But I’m pretty sure there are several laws against it!
lines.zh: : 我……应该没有吧？但我很肯定有好几条法律是禁止的！

lines.en: : Then I guess I’ll just have to start looking for-
lines.zh: : 那我想我得开始找——

lines.en: scene platonicredux3
: Um, wait!
lines.zh: : 呃，等等！

lines.en: : I...suppose I might be making a bigger deal of having a boy in my room than I should...
lines.zh: : 我……想我可能把「让男生进我房间」这件事看得比该有的更严重了……

lines.en: : I mean, how much different could having you around be compared to someone like Miku?
lines.zh: : 我是说，你在这儿跟 Miku 那种人在这儿能有多大区别？

lines.en: : Sure, you're twice my size and...twice my age and...in a position of power and-
lines.zh: : 当然，你体型是我的两倍……年纪是我的两倍……还处在权力的位置上，而且——

lines.en: : Yeah, I get it. Now, are you going to open the door or what?
lines.zh: : 行，我懂了。那么，你到底开不开门？

lines.en: : Y-Yes...
: As long as you’re okay with me...
lines.zh: : 只要你对我的……没问题的话……

lines.en: scene platonicredux5
: Uhh...okay with {i}it!{/i} Not okay with me! Saying {i}me{/i} made it sound like I was insinuating something inappropriate, which I absolutely was not!
lines.zh: : 呃……对{i}这件事{/i}没问题！不是对我这个人没问题！说「对{i}我这个人{/i}」听起来像我在暗示什么不合适的事，而我绝对没有！

lines.en: : I understand that it's totally normal for a teacher to visit a student's dorm room at night and I am going to stop yelling right now because this probably sounds very suspicious!
lines.zh: : 我明白，老师在晚上去学生宿舍房间是完全正常的，而我现在就要停止大喊大叫了，因为这话听起来大概非常可疑！

lines.en: : Good call, Makoto...
lines.zh: : 明智的选择，Makoto……

lines.en: scene black
Of course, I never intended to actually blackmail Makoto.
lines.zh: 当然，我从来没打算真的勒索 Makoto。

lines.en: I haven't been around for long, but even the short amount of time I {i}have{/i} spent here has been way more than sufficient in revealing exactly how much she does for me.
lines.zh: 我在这儿待的时间不长，但就算这么短的时间，也足以让我看清她到底为我做了多少事。

lines.en: In fact, I don't think I've had to sign a single paper yet.
lines.zh: 事实上，我想我连一张纸都还没签过。

lines.en: Signing papers is probably a thing teachers have to do, right?
lines.zh: 签文件大概是老师必须做的事吧？

lines.en: I honestly don't know- which is further proof of exactly how useful Makoto has been.
lines.zh: 我是真不知道——而这更进一步证明了 Makoto 有多有用。

lines.en: I just understand the type of girl she is and I understand how to get what I want out of people like her.
lines.zh: 我只是明白她是什么类型的女孩，也明白怎么从她这种人身上得到我想要的东西。

lines.en: She's lucky I don't want much.
lines.zh: 她运气好，我想要的并不多。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm1
: So...here we are...
lines.zh: : 那么……我们到了……

lines.en: : Just a boy and a girl alone in a [high_school] dorm room...
lines.zh: : 就一个男生和一个女生单独待在一间[high_school]宿舍房间里……

lines.en: : Just...two people in a completely platonic relationship gathering in a private location in the middle of the night...
lines.zh: : 就……两个完全柏拉图式关系的人，在深更半夜聚在一个私密的地方……

lines.en: : Plain old normal stuff. No rules being broken here.
lines.zh: : 再普通不过的事。这里没有违反任何规定。

lines.en: : It's strange that you’re still embarrassed by something like this even after hanging out with me in a building that sells fake vaginas.
lines.zh: : 你跟我在一栋卖假阴道的楼里待过，却还对这种事感到难为情，真是奇怪。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm2
: This is entirely different! You came to the porn shop to buy things, not to see me!
lines.zh: : 这完全不一样！你去色情用品店是买东西的，不是来看我的！

lines.en: : Well...at least the first time!
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少第一次是！

lines.en: : Today, you're actually here for me, though! And I'm just...trying to wrap my head around what that could possibly mean.
lines.zh: : 可今天，你是真的为我而来的！而我只是……在努力搞清楚这可能意味着什么。

lines.en: : Why does it have to mean anything? You should know better than anyone that there's no scientific reason compelling people to come together.
lines.zh: : 为什么非得意味着什么？你应该比谁都清楚，人聚到一起并没有什么科学上的理由。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm3
: Well, actually...there are plenty of scientific reasons that would explain a thing like that. And several of which would likely be relevant here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，实际上……能解释这种事的科学理由多的是，而且其中好几个大概在这儿都适用。

lines.en: : But...you would clearly know that as well, so...chances are you only said there {i}weren't{/i} reasons because you'd prefer I ignore their existence for the time being...
lines.zh: : 但……你显然也知道，所以……你说「{i}没有{/i}理由」，大概只是因为你希望我暂时忽略它们的存在……

lines.en: : Perhaps this is some sort of...riddle, maybe?...But what could you possibly-
lines.zh: : 也许这是某种……谜题什么的？……可你到底想——

lines.en: : Makoto, I just wanted to see you. It's that simple.
lines.zh: : Makoto，我只是想见你。就这么简单。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm4
: It is?...
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Now, if you wanted to spend our time together watching porn, that would be totally acceptable as well.
lines.zh: : 现在，如果你想把我们相处的时间花在看色情片上，我也完全接受。

lines.en: : I understand better than anyone how hard it is being away from that for too long. You don't have to hide your pain from me.
lines.zh: : 我比谁都清楚，太久不碰那个有多难熬。你不用在我面前藏你的痛苦。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm2
: There is no {i}pain!{/i} I'm perfectly comfortable being away from pornography and am in no way dependent on it!
lines.zh: : {i}没有痛苦{/i}！远离色情制品我完全自在，也绝对没有依赖它！

lines.en: : That just sounded like a really complicated way to say you're better than me.
lines.zh: : 那听起来像是在用一种很复杂的方式说你比我强。

lines.en: : Do you truly spend {i}that much{/i} time rotting away your brain with that stuff?
lines.zh: : 你真花{i}那么多{/i}时间用那些东西把脑子泡烂吗？

lines.en: : What if you become addicted and started neglecting your responsibilities as a teacher? That sort of thing can happen, you know.
lines.zh: : 要是你上瘾了、开始荒废你作为老师的职责怎么办？这种事是会发生的，你知道。

lines.en: I'm pretty sure it already has and I have done virtually no teaching whatsoever.
lines.zh: 我很确定那已经发生了，而我基本上什么都没教过。

lines.en: : If that happens I'd...
lines.zh: : 如果真到那一步，我会……

lines.en: : Well, it would probably be up to me to get you back to normal and...
lines.zh: : 嗯，大概得由我来把你弄回正轨，然后……

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm3
: Actually...that does sound like it might be fun now that I think about it...
lines.zh: : 其实……现在想想，那听起来可能还挺有意思的……

lines.en: : Just you and me...studying and...teaching each other all sorts of...
lines.zh: : 就你和我……一起学习……互相教彼此各种各样的……

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm5
: Um...before I start getting excited...do you think it might be okay for me to maybe...help you teach the class one day?
lines.zh: : 呃……在我开始兴奋之前……你觉得，也许……我有一天能帮你上课吗？

lines.en: Was...Makoto about to get turned on from a fantasy of us studying?...
lines.zh: Makoto 刚才差点因为一个我们一起学习的幻想而发情？……

lines.en: : Just...as training, of course. You know, since I plan on becoming a teacher one day and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 只是……当作练习，当然。你知道，因为我打算有一天当老师什么的。

lines.en: : You can teach the class every day if you want. That will give me more time to sleep.
lines.zh: : 你想的话可以每天都来上课。那样我就能有更多时间睡觉了。

lines.en: : I'm not sure if I can let you take over as counselor, though. That seems like more of a {i}me{/i} thing.
lines.zh: : 不过我不确定能不能让你接管「心理咨询」。那看起来更像{i}我{/i}该干的事。

lines.en: It doesn't, really. I just don't want to surrender the opportunity to be alone with a variety of attractive teenage girls.
lines.zh: 其实并不。我只是不想放弃跟各种迷人的青春期女孩独处的机会。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm6
: Oh, umm...funny you should bring that up...because there’s something I’ve been wondering lately.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃……你提到这个还真巧……因为最近有件事我一直想问。

lines.en: : That time we were alone in there and you...you know...massaged me...
lines.zh: : 那次我们单独在里面，然后你……你知道的……给我按摩……

lines.en: : That was, like...just a {i}me{/i} thing, right?...
lines.zh: : 那只是……只对{i}我{/i}做的事，对吧？……

lines.en: : Like...there's no way you're just calling people in there to relieve their stress through...umm...{i}physical{/i} treatment, are you?
lines.zh: : 就……你不可能是在把人叫进去，通过……呃……{i}物理{/i}治疗来帮她们缓解压力吧？

lines.en: : Would there be a problem if I was?
lines.zh: : 如果我是在做那种事，会有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : There would be a multitude of problems if you were.
lines.zh: : 如果你是在做那种事，问题会有一大堆。

lines.en: : But...I'd be able to overlook it if it was just a thing you did for me since...the two of us are close and everything.
lines.zh: : 但……如果那只是你为我做的事，我倒可以睁一只眼闭一只眼，毕竟……我们俩很亲近什么的。

lines.en: : In fact, I...I probably wouldn't have even minded if-
lines.zh: : 事实上，我……我大概甚至不会介意——

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm6r
: A-Actually! I don't even know what I was about to say there.
lines.zh: : 其……其实！我刚才都不知道自己要说什么了。

lines.en: : Please forgive me for my mind being all over the place, Sensei. It's been a long day and...I tend to ramble when I get exhausted.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我思绪乱飘，老师。今天很长，而且……我一累就容易絮叨。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like someone could use another massage.
lines.zh: : 听起来有人需要再来一次按摩。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm2
: You mean...right now?! In my bedroom?! Where the...bed is?!
lines.zh: : 你是说……现在？！在我卧室里？！在……床在的地方？！

lines.en: : That {i}is{/i} typically where you keep the bed, yes.
lines.zh: : 床通常{i}就是{/i}放在那儿，是的。

lines.en: : I...I don't really know if...that's the best place for...
lines.zh: : 我……我真不知道那是不是……最好的地方……

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm6r2
: Just...forget I even asked about the whole massage thing! This is quickly approaching non-platonic levels in my head and that...that would not be good at all.
lines.zh: : 就……当我没问过按摩的事吧！这在我脑子里正飞速滑向非柏拉图的层面，而那……那可一点都不好。

lines.en: I disagree wholeheartedly, but will keep my comments to myself for now so as to not risk scaring her away.
lines.zh: 我完全不同意，但暂时把话咽回肚子里，免得把她吓跑。

lines.en: : I’ve just been really curious about why everyone seems to be in higher spirits lately and...figured your new {i}methods{/i} might have something do with it.
lines.zh: : 我只是很好奇为什么最近大家情绪都这么高涨，就……想是不是你的新{i}方法{/i}跟这有关。

lines.en: : Assuming the...massages are part of your new teaching strategy. Which I am very much hoping they are not for everyone except me
lines.zh: : 假设……按摩是你新教学策略的一部分。而我非常希望它只对我一个人用，不是对所有人。

lines.en: : You're probably just only looking at specific girls or something.
lines.zh: : 你大概只是盯着特定的几个女孩什么的。

lines.en: : I'm sure Ayane has been in high spirits lately because I've been giving her more attention than normal, but I can't imagine someone like Yumi or Maya seeming any different at all.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定 Ayane 最近情绪高涨是因为我给了她比平时更多的关注，但我想象不出 Yumi 或 Maya 那种人会有什么不同。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm7
: But...why only give Ayane more attention than normal? As everyone's teacher, shouldn't you be distributing your time among...well, {i}everyone?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可……为什么要只给 Ayane 比平时更多的关注？作为所有人的老师，你不该把时间分配给……嗯，{i}每个人{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Maybe? That's not really something I think about.
lines.zh: : 也许吧？这真不是我会去想的事。

lines.en: : It...probably should be.
lines.zh: : 这……大概是该想想。

lines.en: : And it probably is. It's just a lot easier to please someone like Ayane than it is to please someone like Yumi, I guess.
lines.zh: : 而且大概就是这么回事。只是取悦 Ayane 那种人比取悦 Yumi 那种人容易得多，我想。

lines.en: : Pleasing Ayane doesn't sound particularly difficult given her...uhh...
lines.zh: : 取悦 Ayane 听起来并不特别难，考虑到她那……呃……

lines.en: : Innate desire to have my children?
lines.zh: : 想给我生孩子的天性？

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm7r
: Can you word it in a slightly less disgusting way next time?
lines.zh: : 下次你能不能用稍微不那么恶心的方式措辞？

lines.en: : It is annoying enough having to listen to the overtly-sexual nonsense coming from her mouth and I don't want to have to hear it coming from yours as well.
lines.zh: : 光是听她嘴里冒出那些露骨的性话就已经够烦了，我可不想再从你嘴里听到一遍。

lines.en: : Is that jealousy I hear, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 我听到的是嫉妒吗，Makoto？

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm8
: Jealous? Me? Don't be absurd.
lines.zh: : 嫉妒？我？别荒谬了。

lines.en: : What would I have to be jealous about, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我有什么好嫉妒的，老师？

lines.en: : Ayane's nonsense is just that, isn't it? Nonsense?
lines.zh: : Ayane 那些胡话就是胡话，不是吗？胡话？

lines.en: : Don't tell me you've actually been up to anything {i}inappropriate{/i} with her.
lines.zh: : 别告诉我你真跟她干了什么{i}不合适{/i}的事。

lines.en: : Can you define {i}inappropriate{/i}, please?
lines.zh: : 你能定义一下「{i}不合适{/i}」吗？

lines.en: : Do I really have to?
lines.zh: : 我真得回答吗？

lines.en: : You know what? I'm just going to go with no. That seems like the safe answer.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我就当答案是「没有」了。那听起来比较安全。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm2
: I take exception to how uncertain you sound right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在的语气这么不确定，我很不满。

lines.en: : The two of you aren’t involved in some sort of...illicit relationship, are you?
lines.zh: : 你俩不会是卷进了什么……不正当关系吧？

lines.en: : Can you define {i}illicit{/i}, please?
lines.zh: : 你能定义一下「{i}不正当{/i}」吗？

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm8r
: {size=-15}That fucking bitch...{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}那个操蛋的婊子……{/size}

lines.en: : Makoto?

: Yes, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是，老师？

lines.en: : You doing okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Of course, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 当然，老师。

lines.en: : Good...Well, just to reiterate, nothing weird is going on in my office and I'll do my best to contain my unearthly desire to massage everyone to you and you only.
lines.zh: : 好……那么再重申一遍，我办公室里没发生什么奇怪的事，而我会尽最大努力把我那股想给所有人按摩的超自然欲望控制住，只对你一个人。

lines.en: : I greatly appreciate that. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我非常感激。谢谢。

lines.en: : Any time. So, feel free to stop by my office whenever you like.
lines.zh: : 随时乐意。所以，随时欢迎来我办公室找我。

lines.en: : Absolutely. I’ve been meaning to drop by recently anyway.
lines.zh: : 当然。我最近反正也一直想过去。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Why's that?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？为什么？

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm6
: I just...realized it might be time for me to start thinking about college and wanted to explore some options with you.
lines.zh: : 我只是……觉得也许是时候开始考虑大学的事了，想跟你探讨几个选项。

lines.en: Why is she already thinking about that as a freshman? Shouldn't she be focusing more on just...making it through high school first?
lines.zh: 她一个新生为什么已经在想那个了？她不该先专注于……把高中念完吗？

lines.en: : You sure you don’t want a massage instead?
lines.zh: : 你确定不要来个按摩？

lines.en: if day26 == True:
: I’m sure. And I already told you that we probably shouldn’t be doing that stuff in[school], didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我确定。而且我说过了，那种事我们大概不该在[school]里做，对吧？

lines.en: : Save your massages for when we're somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 把你的按摩留到我们在别的地方的时候。

lines.en: : Just not in school and not in your bedroom...
lines.zh: : 只要不在学校、也不在你卧室里……

lines.en: : Wait. Does that mean-
lines.zh: : 等等。那是不是意味着——

lines.en: : I would sooner die than allow you to massage me at my work.
lines.zh: : 我死也不会让你在我工作的地方给我按摩。

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 操。

lines.en: else:
: Very sure. School is clearly not the place for things like that.
lines.zh: : 非常确定。学校显然不是干那种事的地方。

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm7
: As for everywhere else, though...I think it might be okay under the right circumstances...
lines.zh: : 至于别的地方嘛……我想在合适的条件下也许可以……

lines.en: : Those circumstances being?...
lines.zh: : 那些条件是什么？……

lines.en: scene makotofirstdorm8
: I'm not quite sure as I've yet to make a list.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定，因为我还没列个清单。

lines.en: : It would have to be on rare occasions only, though. I’m afraid I’d become too dependent on your {i}skills{/i} if you were to just start rubbing my shoulders each time we met.
lines.zh: : 不过必须只限于罕见的场合。我怕你要是每次见面就揉我的肩，我会太依赖你的{i}技术{/i}。

lines.en: : I mean... there are {i}other{/i} areas I can-
lines.zh: : 我是说……还有些{i}别的{/i}部位我也能——

lines.en: : Don't you dare finish that sentence.
lines.zh: : 你敢把那句话说完试试。

lines.en: : What's wrong? I was obviously just referring to your back and your neck and...an assortment of other safe-for-work areas.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？我显然只是在说你的背、你的脖子，还有……一堆别的职场安全区。

lines.en: : Let’s just stick to the shoulders for now, okay?
lines.zh: : 我们先就只按肩膀，好吗？

lines.en: scene black
Makoto and I hang out for a little while longer and, unfortunately, the topic of massages fizzles out.
lines.zh: Makoto 和我又待了一会儿，可惜按摩的话题就这么凉了。

lines.en: I was pretty confident I'd at least get to {i}touch{/i} her tonight on account of our apparent mutual {i}interest{/i} in one another, but-
lines.zh: 我本来挺有把握今晚至少能{i}碰到{/i}她的，考虑到我们之间那明显的互相{i}兴趣{/i}，可是——

lines.en: Perhaps she's not interested in the same way I am just yet?
lines.zh: 也许她还没用跟我一样的方式感兴趣？

lines.en: She'll get there soon enough, though.
lines.zh: 不过她早晚会的。

lines.en: There's only so much willpower a person can have- and when you're surrounded by sex on a day-to-day basis, I can't imagine that not eating away at you.
lines.zh: 一个人能有的意志力是有限的——而当你每天都被性的东西包围，我很难想象它不会慢慢啃噬你。

lines.en: Being alone with the person you admire will only exacerbate that craving.
lines.zh: 跟你仰慕的人单独相处只会加剧那种渴望。

lines.en: She can block out her curiosities as much as she wants, but the walls keeping them contained will only hold for so long- and I will be the one to hold her after that.
lines.zh: 她想把好奇心挡在外面多少次都行，但关着它们的墙撑不了多久——而之后，托住她的人会是我。

lines.en: Eventually, the two of us decide it's best for me to leave as Miku informs Makoto that she's on the way home.
lines.zh: 最后，Miku 通知 Makoto 她正在回家的路上，我俩觉得我该走了。

lines.en: And just like that, without even a moment of contact, I'm headed back to my house...
lines.zh: 就这么着，连一秒钟的接触都没有，我就往我家走了……
